highlights: Accounts tab: every Gate and Boros account in one list, and one health status in the header
Roll into a new maturity without closing the old legs, and pay only the opening fee
Boros pair ticket: pick the coin, then the markets, then a maturity both list; each market shows its collateral
Safer Boros closes: both legs close in one batch, and your resting orders on those markets are cancelled with them
Boros opens exit your matured markets first, so an account full of old markets can still trade
Updates keep your port and folder, and Windows installs recover on their own
